row: D’Youville is a nationally-ranked private university headquartered in Buffalo, New York, providing in-seat and online academic programs around the world. Founded in 1908, D’Youville offers undergraduate, graduate, and post-doctoral degrees in liberal arts, business, and healthcare. D’Youville’s small class sizes, experiential education, and interprofessional learning environments prepare students for success. For more information, visit dyu.edu.
